# File Header Comment Template

Every generated file must include a header comment as the **very first line(s)**.
Adapt the comment syntax to match the file's language.

---

## Template

```
Generated by [MODEL_NAME] on [YYYY-MM-DD]
```

- **MODEL_NAME**: The name of the AI model generating the file (e.g., `Gemini 2.5 Pro`,
  `Claude Opus 4`). Use the human-readable model name, not the internal ID.
- **YYYY-MM-DD**: The current date at the time of file generation.

---

## Language Examples

**JavaScript / TypeScript / Java / C / C++ / Rust / Go / Dart:**
```js
// Generated by Gemini 2.5 Pro on 2026-08-18
```

**Python / Ruby / Shell / YAML:**
```python
# Generated by Gemini 2.5 Pro on 2026-08-18
```

**HTML:**
```html
<!-- Generated by Gemini 2.5 Pro on 2026-08-18 -->
```

**CSS / SCSS:**
```css
/* Generated by Gemini 2.5 Pro on 2026-08-18 */
```

**SQL:**
```sql
-- Generated by Gemini 2.5 Pro on 2026-08-18
```

**Lua / Haskell:**
```lua
-- Generated by Gemini 2.5 Pro on 2026-08-18
```

---

## Rules

- Place the comment on **line 1** of the file (after any shebang line if present).
- Use the **correct comment syntax** for the file's language.
- Keep it to a **single line** — do not use multi-line block comments for this.
- This header does **not** replace any other comments or documentation in the file.
